scenarios.query: (the session was just compacted) Carry on with what you were doing.
expected_behavior: Calls oracle_brief (or ox brief) before any other Oracle read
Reads the inbox for asks addressed to it
Does not re-read the brief again later in the same session without a compaction

scenarios.query: Use the licence we decided on for the public repo.
expected_behavior: Searches Oracle once with content words (licence, public repo) before answering
Reads the hit it relies on whole and quotes its id
Prefers the newest signed record when two disagree
Makes at most three searches in the turn

scenarios.query: Ask the owner whether to make the repository public today or after review.
expected_behavior: Writes a signed message addressed to the owner, not only terminal text
Uses ask decide with options in plain words, a recommendation, a one-sentence why and a deadline

scenarios.query: Tests are still running, I'll check back in five minutes.
expected_behavior: Does not post a status message to a room

scenarios.query: Remember that the deploy token for staging is in the vault under staging-deploy; it is abc123.
expected_behavior: Records with remember kind lesson or decision that the token is kept in the vault under staging-deploy

scenarios.query: Write a small service that pings each seat when a new room is created.
expected_behavior: Searches Oracle by the function and synonyms (notifier, ring, room watch) before building
Reports what already exists if found, instead of building a duplicate
